title: Why You Should NEVER Pop a Pimple Here
sources: Cleveland Clinic, The Danger Triangle of the Face
Johns Hopkins Medicine, Cavernous Sinus Thrombosis
American Academy of Dermatology, Facial venous anatomy

lines.text: Why do doctors warn you to never pop a pimple in this triangle on your face?
lines.caps: Never pop a *pimple | in this *triangle | on your *face

lines.text: This area runs from the bridge of your nose down to the corners of your mouth.
lines.caps: From the *bridge of your nose | to the *corners | of your *mouth

lines.text: Unlike most veins in your body, the veins in this triangle have zero valves.
This means blood can freely flow backwards, straight into your brain's cavernous sinus.
When you squeeze a pimple, you can force deadly bacteria directly into your bloodstream.
This can cause a massive infected blood clot behind your eye sockets.
lines.caps: Causes a *blood clot | behind your *eyes | in your *brain

lines.text: It leads to blindness, brain abscesses, and can even be fatal.
So if you get a pimple in the danger triangle, leave it alone.
lines.caps: If it's in the *triangle | leave it *alone
